ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A dominant, contiguous high-intensity white field covers the lateral half of the left lobe, bisected by a dark 'X' pattern. The central area and majority of the right lobe consist of low-intensity black pixels, with high-contrast white streaks appearing on the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 110 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel peaks and valleys along the trailing edge; extreme serration and jagged clustering are concentrated on the distal tips of both lobes, likely due to external calcification.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a convex trailing edge curve that sweeps sharply upwards towards the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least four circular high-contrast ring scars (rosettes): three located within the white field of the left lobe and one on the central black boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, dark 'X' shaped intersecting linear marks on the left lobe; multiple parallel vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) on the distal white tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue growth and calcification (barnacle colonies) on both distal lobe tips; permanent traumatic scar in an 'X' configuration on the left fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated dark circular focal point (pixel cluster) resembling an eye-spot located in the upper-left quadrant of the white pigmentation area.
